entries.notes: All three TypeScript declarations are translated. Coverage preserves CLIENT span identity; exact run, stream, and operation attributes; numeric time-to-first-non-empty-chunk and connect durations; connect not exceeding TTFC; drained-only completion totals; raw payload byte counts for WorkflowServerReadableStream; framed wire-byte counts including each four-byte header; and reconnect totals. Final GREEN must instrument the real Rust World read and framed reconnect paths, use monotonic elapsed timing, and keep telemetry fire-and-forget so a missing or failing exporter cannot alter stream delivery.
